scope: All 33 exact missing P0/P1 drafts for Latin la, Interlingua ia and Tok Pisin tpi; no other translations or production files edited.
source_provenance: The supplied baseline was reported to have production-string parity with PR 242 despite infrastructure-only changes; this original review verified local English values and exact missing sets, not the remote head.

context_evidence.detail: Lines 45 and 59 use ui_fg/ui_bg as compact swatch captions; refresh supplies separate full accessible foreground/background labels. Horizontal labels combine caption with hex colour and scale to width.
ui_main23 appears next to ui_drawing23 and ui_colour_tab23. This supports only a provisional generic main-section/tab interpretation, not a verified call site or palette-specific referent.

Search of Paintroid/src/main outside localized resource catalogues found only the ui_fg/ui_bg call sites among the queried Main, Fit image, pinch/pan mode, derived-export warning and palette-template resources. Absence here is not a global proof of dead code.

limitations: This is an independent linguistic/resource review, not device UI acceptance or a native-speaker certification. No blanket native-speaker gate is imposed.
Medium-confidence local abbreviations, long navigation labels, and the generic Main context remain explicitly noted per item; none is silently promoted to observed runtime fact.

entries.name: formats22_derived_exported
entries.english: %1$s exported. Your full drawing still has unsaved changes; save a full image copy before replacing it.
entries.draft_value: Exportatio %1$s perfecta est. Pictura tua integra adhuc mutationes non servatas continet; exemplar imaginis integrae serva antequam picturam substituas.
entries.reviewed_value: Exportatio %1$s perfecta est. Pictura tua integra adhuc mutationes non servatas continet; exemplar imaginis integrae serva antequam picturae aliam substituas.
entries.xml_ready_value: Exportatio %1$s perfecta est. Pictura tua integra adhuc mutationes non servatas continet; exemplar imaginis integrae serva antequam picturae aliam substituas.
entries.xml_element: <string name="formats22_derived_exported">Exportatio %1$s perfecta est. Pictura tua integra adhuc mutationes non servatas continet; exemplar imaginis integrae serva antequam picturae aliam substituas.</string>
entries.backtranslation: Export of %1$s is complete. Your whole drawing still contains unsaved changes; save a copy of the whole image before substituting another drawing for it.
entries.rationale: Correct the replacement direction: in substituere X Y, X is the replacement and Y is the displaced item. The draft picturam substituas risks making the current drawing the replacement. Picturae aliam substituas explicitly makes another drawing the replacement for the current drawing. Export completion, whole drawing, still-unsaved changes, whole-image copy, and before-replacement timing all remain.
entries.residual_uncertainty: Modern export/save vocabulary is retained consistently with this catalogue; not a claim of classical usage or native-speaker validation.

references.purpose: Lewis and Short / Gaffiot construction: the accusative is the new substitute; the displaced item can be dative or pro + ablative. Search-result full entry inspected; direct open returned cache miss.

entries.name: ui_bg
entries.rationale: F is compact, distinct from foreground PP, and based on the existing fundus wording. It is a swatch caption, not the sole accessible label.
entries.residual_uncertainty: F is a locally chosen abbreviation, not claimed to be a standardized Latin UI convention; recognizability and visual fit were not user-tested.

entries.name: ui_fg
entries.rationale: PP transparently uses the two initials of the established catalogue term primum planum and stays within the compact caption role.
entries.residual_uncertainty: A locally chosen abbreviation, not a claimed standardized convention; separate full accessible labels are present in source.

entries.name: ui_fit_image
entries.rationale: Accusative imaginem plus imperative accommoda is grammatical and consistent with the existing accommodare family. It does not introduce a destination absent from the English.
entries.residual_uncertainty: The source does not establish whether this fits into a view or onto a canvas; the translation intentionally leaves that unspecified.

entries.name: ui_foreground_background_colour_palette
entries.draft_value: Color primi plani %1$s, color fundi %2$s. Tabula colorum: %3$s.
entries.reviewed_value: Color primi plani %1$s, color fundi %2$s. Tabula colorum: %3$s.
entries.xml_ready_value: Color primi plani %1$s, color fundi %2$s. Tabula colorum: %3$s.

entries.backtranslation: Foreground colour %1$s, background colour %2$s. Colour palette: %3$s.
entries.rationale: Primi plani and fundi are appropriate dependent genitives; all three source roles survive. The colon avoids needing to inflect an arbitrary palette name.
entries.residual_uncertainty: No runtime call site for this template was found in the inspected production source.

entries.name: ui_main23
entries.rationale: Principalis is a reasonable standalone primary-section label. No noun such as palette is added, so the translation does not claim an unverified palette-specific referent.
entries.residual_uncertainty: Runtime referent is unverified; adjacent Drawing and Color resources suggest a tab/section label, not proof of a call site. Standalone adjective is accepted for this generic label.

entries.name: ui_pinch_and_pan_mode
entries.draft_value: Modus magnificationis mutandae et conspectus movendi duobus digitis
entries.reviewed_value: Modus magnificationis mutandae et conspectus movendi duobus digitis
entries.xml_ready_value: Modus magnificationis mutandae et conspectus movendi duobus digitis
entries.xml_element: <string name="ui_pinch_and_pan_mode">Modus magnificationis mutandae et conspectus movendi duobus digitis</string>
entries.backtranslation: Mode for changing magnification and moving the view with two fingers.
entries.rationale: The coordinated gerundive phrases are grammatical and preserve both zoom change and panning. Magnification change does not imply pixel resampling or image dimensions; duobus digitis supplies the touch gesture.
entries.residual_uncertainty: The modern technical paraphrase is long (67 characters); no rendered width or wrapping check was performed. It is not shortened at the cost of either action.

entries.reviewed_value: %1$s exportate. Tu designo complete contine ancora modificationes non salveguardate; salveguarda un copia del imagine complete ante de reimplaciar le designo.

entries.backtranslation: %1$s exported. Your complete drawing still contains unsaved changes; save a copy of the complete image before replacing the drawing.
entries.rationale: All safety clauses are explicit. Ancora keeps the still-unsaved distinction after export, complete scopes both drawing and image copy, and le designo resolves the replacement referent.
entries.residual_uncertainty: No production call site was found for this source resource; no claim that an export saved the working drawing.

entries.name: ui_main23
entries.backtranslation: Main / principal (literally number one; also first or best in other contexts).
entries.rationale: Replace Bikpela, which can label size, with Nambawan in its chief/principal sense. This is a short generic primary-section label; it adds neither palette nor a fabricated page/call-site referent. Ross records nambawan with the gloss chief, principal.
entries.residual_uncertainty: Nambawan is also ordinal/evaluative; the generic primary-tab interpretation is an informed contextual choice, not verified runtime or native-speaker acceptance. A runtime size-control meaning would require revisiting it, but that is not the supplied English.

references.purpose: Malcolm Ross, Current use and expansion of Tok Pisin: effects of Tok Pisin on some vernacular languages, printed p. 541 / PDF p. 3, records nambawan: chief, principal. Lexical support only, not UI validation.

entries.name: ui_pinch_and_pan_mode
entries.draft_value: Mod bilong zum wantaim tupela pinga na muvim viw
entries.reviewed_value: Mod bilong zum wantaim tupela pinga na muvim viw
entries.xml_ready_value: Mod bilong zum wantaim tupela pinga na muvim viw
entries.xml_element: <string name="ui_pinch_and_pan_mode">Mod bilong zum wantaim tupela pinga na muvim viw</string>
entries.backtranslation: Mode for zooming with two fingers and moving the view.
entries.rationale: Functional wording explicitly includes both two-finger zoom and moving the view. Existing zum, tupela pinga and viw terms support consistency; it does not describe resizing image pixels.
entries.residual_uncertainty: Pinch is paraphrased as two-finger zoom rather than borrowed literally. Rendering and spontaneous user comprehension were not tested.
